props.text: Financing trucks and trailers at Summit Ridge
We take the guesswork out of financing the equipment that keeps you moving.

At Summit Ridge Truck Center we know the trucking business from the inside. We offer competitive rates and flexible financing through our network of commercial lenders, and our finance team makes the decision simpler by laying out your options side by side.

If you’ve decided to finance your next truck, you’re in good company — most of our customers do. With a reasonable down payment and approved credit, you can arrange financing with us and get on the road quickly.

You can also roll in parts, accessories, upfits, warranties and insurance, so everything the truck needs is covered by one monthly payment.

And because we finance trucks every day, we understand what matters most to you: getting the truck working as soon as possible. That’s why we keep the process quick.

values.heading: Financing options tailored to the way you work
values.intro: Structures can be combined and matched to your cash flow, season and duty cycle. Tell us how the equipment earns and we’ll show you which of these fit.

cards.title: Retail financing
cards.text: A straightforward finance contract that can roll in the bodywork, upfit and other costs of putting a truck into service, so the whole job is covered by one loan.

cards.title: Municipal leasing
cards.text: Tax-exempt leasing helps cities, counties, school districts, utilities and other public agencies get the equipment they need while staying inside annual budget limits.

cards.title: Equal monthly
cards.text: The same payment every month for the life of the contract — the simplest structure to plan around.

cards.title: Skip payment
cards.text: Built for seasonal work: choose the months you need to protect cash flow and skip the truck payment while the work is slow.

cards.title: Balloon payment
cards.text: Set 5%, 10% or 15% of the amount financed aside as a final payment. Lower monthly payments now, with the balance due at the end of the term.

cards.title: Accelerated payment
cards.text: Pay more early and less later. You build equity faster and save interest, and payments drop as maintenance costs start to rise.

cards.title: Extended warranty
cards.text: Ridgeline Protect extended warranties come in 1-, 2-, 3- and 4-year terms, and can be added to a truck you already own.

cards.title: Financed extended warranties
cards.text: Paying cash for the truck but want the warranty spread out? Finance a 1- to 4-year extended warranty at 0% interest with a low down payment.

cards.title: GAP coverage
cards.text: Covers the difference between what you owe and what the truck is worth if it is totalled or stolen, so a bad day doesn’t become a debt.

cards.title: Repair financing
cards.text: Spread the cost of major engine overhauls, transmission work or component replacements over manageable monthly payments.
